sections.title: Legal and Institutional Norms
sections.content: You know *szabad* and *tilos* + infinitive from A2 Unit 23, *kötelező* from the same unit and *megengedett* ('allowed') is new here. Rules in public life are stated the same way: *tilos pártpropagandát folytatni* ('it is forbidden to run party propaganda'), *kötelező közmeghallgatást tartani* ('it is mandatory to hold a public hearing').

items.spanish: A választások idején tilos a szavazóhelyiségben pártpropagandát folytatni.
items.english: During elections it is prohibited to conduct party propaganda inside polling stations.
It is mandatory for local governments to hold a public hearing.
